messages:
Marta: FYI — RivetAnalytics is showing a steady drop in API usage. DAU down ~45% over the last 14 days, seats unchanged. Flagging as potential renewal risk.
Oliver: Any recent contract milestones or POC wrapups we should know about?
Sam: I reached out to their champion (emailed last Wed). They said engineering paused new automation work but didn't mention churn. No procurement flags in SFDC yet.
Nina: Support side: ticket volume is low but there's an outstanding feature request backlog. I reopened ticket #5421 after their PM replied.
Ethan: Telemetry note — after the runtime v2.1 rollout in us-west we saw 20% higher p95 for long-context requests from their org id. Could be contributing to drop. @eng-runtime might need to triage.
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy complete: runtime v2.1 -> us-west at 2026-03-18T03:14:22Z (commit ab12f3c) :white_check_mark:
Marta: Good catch, Ethan. Let's not assume churn yet but treat as high-priority. Proposed next steps: quick triage call with their CTO + PM, align on blockers, and propose short-term mitigations (rollback or perf knobs) while we investigate.
Sam: I'll open a scheduling thread. Do we want to offer a temporary performance credit (1 month) or first try a technical mitigation?
Oliver: Hold credits until we understand root cause. Offer a joint remediation plan + can present Dedicated/quantization options if they ask for cost/speed tradeoffs. Also they mentioned competitor trial (CompetitorX) in the PM notes — prep a side-by-side summary.
Marta: Action items: @Sam schedule 30m with CTO + PM this week; @Nina pull ticket history & recent NPS/CSAT comments; @Ethan prepare a quick perf runbook and rollback plan; @Oliver draft a 1-page competitor comparison and potential commercial flex. I'll write the outreach message.
Sam: Scheduling now. Targeting Thu morning PT. Attaching the API usage snippet showing the drop for their key:
```
2026-03-01 00:00 - 1200 reqs/day
2026-03-10 00:00 - 680 reqs/day
2026-03-17 00:00 - 640 reqs/day
```
Nina: Added ticket dump to the shared drive: /shared/customer-success/rivetanalytics/tickets.csv. Noted two escalation threads about "slowness for batch jobs" in Jan/Feb.
Ethan: I'll run against a staging rollback (v2.0) and measure p95 for their payloads. If we can reproduce, we can propose a temporary rollback during the customer window.
Oliver: I'll have the competitor one-pager by EOD tomorrow. Also flagging procurement: if they say they're evaluating CompetitorX ask who owns the procurement decision — could trigger an SDR outreach.
Marta: Outreach draft in #docus-templates, will post after Sam confirms time. Keep this thread posted — updating after the call. :calendar:
